description: This file defines the AxisText class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for chart axis text properties such as rotation and font.

classes.name: AxisText
classes.description: Represents axis text properties in a chart, including rotation and font settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AxisText object, setting default font size.

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the axis text.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Retrieves the current rotation angle of the axis text.

methods.name: getFillColorObject
methods.description: Returns the chart color object associated with the font's fill color, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the Font object used for the axis text.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the Font object for the axis text.
